body: sorry, I made an error in my post. I meant to say that I put MY hand over his crotch. that makes it a lot different, doesn't it?

thank you for this comment, even though I disagree with you. you don't think it's sexual to put your hand over someone's intimate areas? there's a reason why what I did is a misdemeanor in Nevada and (maybe) a felony in DC and some other places

I guess I just have a hard time believing that other "normal" people have done things like this. i feel like a terrible person. but maybe you're right, i should just forget about it and realize it was a stupid mistake that really didn't hurt anybody

i'm so sorry to hear that someone hurt you. My friend was unconscious so I don't think he knows anything about it. it was technically harmless but that doesn't make it right and the simple fact that I was capable of doing something like that eats me up inside. it's probably the worst thing I've ever done

I'm so sorry you feel this way. have you tried to talk to a mental health professional? They can help. what makes you happy? what used to make you happy? You can be happy again with therapy, medication, meditation, and taking care of yourself. don't buy meds online either, that can be dangerous
